## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **companion catalog** to **Eun's** principal importation catalog ([KR6s0114](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0114)), focused specifically on **vinaya** (*lǜ* 律) materials brought back from Tang. Preserved at T55 no. 2168B.

**Abstract**

Companion to [KR6s0114](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0114). *notBefore* = **847**, *notAfter* = **847**. Catalog dynasty 日本. The work documents the **vinaya** subset of Eun's importation, separately catalogued for the Heian-court vinaya-establishment review.

See [KR6s0114](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0114) for substantive treatment of Eun.
